title: Boston Gas Company submits for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Bardon Trimount d/b/a Aggregate Industries (Peabody).
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Transportation Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms under the agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protetition from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating,Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre Manning. (GC 00-25)
